The final database layer does not promote fallback rows: three DBAASP machine candidates remain unresolved candidate-only records, authoritative linked row counts are zero, source_verified count is zero, and no final object contains both sequence and sequence_length. All required paths were readable. Final counts are activity 6, toxicity 5, database audits 3, mechanism claims 5, review rework targets 0. Live packet open tickets are 0 and match review-report open-ticket fields.

The direct_assay_types field lists only SEM and the limitation note says TEM was not retained, so the claim text remains internally inconsistent and source-unsupported.

Paper identity is source-confirmed: PMC13066039, PMID 41954813, DOI 10.1186/s11671-026-04498-6, Discover Nano 2026, and the title match staged materials and packet metadata. Entity linkage remains cautionary because nisin is identified only as paper-local reagent/AMP context with a 34-amino-acid descriptor, while exact one-letter sequence and authoritative database row linkage are absent.

The integrity check still fails because the current finals leave the PDF Fig. 8a hemolysis endpoint unresolved and keep unsupported TEM wording in a direct mechanism claim.

No final mechanism source_locator/supporting_source_locators entry points to project work/final artifacts, strict current recursive hard-finding count is 0, and fallback DBAASP rows are explicitly machine-only, unresolved, excluded from release/portal/authoritative ingest, and authoritative_ingest_ready=false.

The database layer preserves unresolved/no-authoritative-row status, but the final review_report contains an unsupported caution-cross-database-conflict-preserved object with conflict_count=1. Current database evidence says linked APD6/DBAASP/DRAMP rows are absent, source_conflict count is 0, and cross-database conflicts are not adjudicable, so the caution conflates absent authority rows with an actual preserved conflict.

The staged source supplementary directories are readable and empty; packet supplementary_index lists no files, supplementary_text has zero records, supplementary_tables is empty, archive_manifest has no archives, and extraction_error_count is 0. No final accepted row depends on a missing supplementary asset.

The five text-supported cell viability/selectivity rows match XML/PDF values for NIH-3T3 and HCT-116. However, the primary PDF visibly contains Fig. 8a percent hemolysis bars and XML p42 describes hemolysis as part of biosafety; the final emits zero percent-hemolysis toxicity records and only an unresolved exclusion/gap. That leaves a material toxicity surface omitted from publication-grade row-level evidence.

blocking_findings.reason: The current activity_toxicity_evidence final leaves a source-present toxicity endpoint unresolved. Primary XML p42 and Fig. 8 plus PDF page 12 show a percent hemolysis assay surface for fresh mouse red blood with P-AgNPs and NP-AgNPs2 treatment conditions, but final toxicity_records contains no percent hemolysis row and only the exclusion PMC13066039-tox-excl-hemolysis-001 because text extraction did not recover numeric values. Since the primary PDF was available and visually inspected, publication-grade toxicity coverage cannot accept this as a nonblocking omission.

cautions.summary: No linked authoritative DBAASP/APD6/DRAMP rows are present. The current finals preserve the three fallback machine rows as unresolved candidate-only evidence and keep authoritative_ingest_ready=false, so fallback release boundary is preserved even though publication-grade paper acceptance fails on other fields.

The current strict acceptance artifact reports publication_grade=true and zero hard findings, but independent source review found unresolved hemolysis coverage and unsupported TEM wording. Deterministic/green gate status is therefore not sufficient terminal evidence for this paper.
